title: A kutatási célú ágentikus AI 2026-ban — Helyzetkép és iránymutató
description: Hungarian-language AI-powered interactive learning platform and e-book (19 chapters, ~100,000 words) covering AI for scientific research — from conversational AI to autonomous research agents. Includes interactive tutor webapp with RAG chat, 209 quiz questions, 99-concept dependency graph, and domain applications in precision agriculture, hydroinformatics, and geoinformatics. Developed to support AI transition at the University of Debrecen.
